name: Onesource Specialty Pharma Ltd
title: Onesource Specialty Pharma Ltd - 544292 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue rebounded 47% QoQ to INR4,282m on Semaglutide launches, but capacity is fully committed and a new line only comes online next quarter, with FY28 guidance of $400m and ~40% EBITDA margin reiterated.

utilisation.quote: Our current line which is today running is fully committed back-to-back.

capex.quote: As a part of the US$ 100 million capex which we are doing, the new line which has been installed already a couple of months back is currently undergoing qualification

triggers.label: Current line fully committed back-to-back
triggers.quote: Our current line which is today running is fully committed back-to-back.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue +47% QoQ to INR4,282m
triggers.quote: our revenues stood at INR4,282 million. It reflects a strong 47% sequential growth

triggers.label: Working capital elevated; inventory INR440cr vs INR158cr
triggers.quote: there are elevated levels, but all of that essentially to prepare for the long launches

triggers.label: FY28 $400m and 40% EBITDA reiterated
triggers.quote: we are confident of a strong FY '27 and also reiterate our FY '28 guidance of US$ 400 million revenue and 40% EBITDA margin

guidance.quote: reaffirm our long-term guidance of FY '28, which is a US$400 million of organic revenue with around 40% of EBITDA margins
reiterate our FY '28 guidance of US$ 400 million revenue and 40% EBITDA margin
we expect that capacity to be available to us in Q2, in time with increasing demands
building towards the 50% plus ROCE expectation that we have for ourselves during the medium term

prior_guidance_check.quote: as guided earlier in our conversations, you would see an uptick on our quarterly performances going forward
reiterate our FY '28 guidance of US$ 400 million revenue and 40% EBITDA margin

red_flags.label: Inventory INR158cr to INR440cr, pass-through claimed
red_flags.quote: our inventories have moved from INR158 crores in March '25 to INR440 crores in March '26

red_flags.label: RPT scheme deferred after investor pushback
red_flags.quote: We didn't get that same comfort this time, although we would have got through majority without difficulties

red_flags.label: Opex rising ahead of revenue
red_flags.quote: there is significant amount of investments both in P&L as well as balance sheet without commensurate revenue

red_flags.label: Management declines to disclose biologics revenue or EBITDA
red_flags.quote: we don't really break it down in that granularity business-wise

evasions.quote: we neither do we talk about which customers we have or the terms which are with them
whether it is breaking even already or not, I will not get into that
we will stay right now with FY28 guidance

evasions.topic: Canada approvals timing for other clients
evasions.quote: that's a question which we are not directly involved in managing the regulatory strategy
